name: Driving QA Benchmark
description: A benchmark dataset of 160k question-answer pairs derived from 10k driving scenarios, designed to evaluate multimodal large language models on understanding driving contexts, answering questions, and decision-making in autonomous driving.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the autonomous driving literature that is not yet widely used as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Includes a new evaluation metric for Driving QA; dataset generated with RL agent and teacher LLM (GPT-3.5).
